w_bar.prompt:
Attachment 1 is a flat-color blockout of one building front. Attachment 2 is a finished piece of this set: match its painting technique, colors and amount of detail exactly. Attachment 3 shows the world, the density and the seedy pleasure-quarter mood of this town: stacked shacks, tents, hanging cloth, crowded stalls, neon of the brothels and taverns (use it only for that; do not copy its layout or its lanterns, and keep the darker brightness of attachment 3, not brighter).

Painting technique: painterly digital oil-paint concept art for a game background. Visible thick brushstrokes, rich color, strong light-and-shadow contrast. Not a classical old-master painting, not a photograph, not anime line art.

World: the entrance of the back town of an empire's capital, a chaotic pleasure quarter and slum like the Kowloon Walled City, under iron scaffolding. Taverns, a cabaret, gambling machines, a brothel-like inn and shady dealers stand side by side; the air is boozy, smoky and a little dangerous. Magitech everywhere (magic fused with over-advanced technology): rune circuits glowing along pipes, lamps that mix crystals and brass machinery. Colors: dark violet, iron and brass, warm amber light from the taverns, neon in violet, green, cyan and pink. Not medieval, not a modern city, not a Japanese Showa-era alley. No paper lanterns.

View: a flat front elevation facing the viewer straight on. No perspective, no vanishing point. Vertical lines stay vertical, horizontal lines stay horizontal. Anything that sticks out (awning, counter) is painted flat on the surface, with its depth shown only by shading and cast shadow.

Keep the position, outline and size of every shape in attachment 1 exactly as it is, and paint over it. Keep the thin pure magenta (#FF00FF) strips at the left and right edges pure flat magenta. Output exactly the same size as attachment 1 (1536 x 1024).

This piece: the front of a cheap, crowded back-street tavern, the main building of this street (7.5 m wide, 5 m high; the door on the right is 2.6 m tall for scale). Blockout colors: dark red-brown = an old patched brick wall with soot stains, pipes and cables; the brass rectangle at the top = the tavern's brass signboard with an abstract symbol of a mug and a bottle, NOT glowing; the violet strip = the edge of a stained cloth awning; the black frame = the wide open front of the tavern; inside it, the dark green area = shelves packed with liquor bottles of many shapes, some with faintly glowing magical liquids, brass taps and a small copper distilling machine with pipes; the inside of the tavern is lit with warm amber light, a little smoky; the brown block at the bottom of the opening = the wooden bar counter seen from the street, scratched, with mugs and bottles on top; the brown rectangle on the right = a heavy wooden door with iron bands, slightly open with warm light leaking out (keep its shape exactly; it is an entrance). Nobody inside: no bartender and no customers (the game adds them).

Lighting: the brick wall and the street side are dark and dim; the warm amber light of the tavern's interior and the door gap are the brightest parts. No neon on this building (the game adds its neon sign separately).

Signs show only abstract symbols and shapes, never readable letters. Do not draw any people, UI or text.
